purpose: Contract for the King contact-QC layer over Growth Contact Intelligence. Discovery-agnostic; nothing here scrapes or sends. Term/year is NEVER invented.

sources.growth_public_contacts: chapter + club contacts owned by this system (editable)
sources.campus_council_contacts: council contacts owned by Campus Backfill (READ-ONLY; QC state stored separately)
sources.growth_business_clubs: business-club orgs owned by this system
sources.growth_advisors: normalized shared-advisor identity (one per email) with M:N links
sources.growth_contact_qc: polymorphic QC + eligibility + King queue state across ALL sources
sources.growth_outreach_eligibility: view exposing the reusable outreach-eligibility shape

fields.contact_source: which table the contact lives in
fields.council_id: null — councils are keyed by (campus_id, council_type)
fields.council_type: ifc | panhellenic | nphc | mgc when applicable
fields.source: source_url the value was verified on
fields.effective_term: e.g. 'Fall 2026' — NULL when not established (never invented)

freshness_rules.stable: role_inbox, organization_general, staff_advisor, social_account, official general email — persist across terms
freshness_rules.current: named officer WITH effective_term matching the active term (none today — 0% term data)
freshness_rules.verify_before_use: named student_officer / chapter_exec WITHOUT current-term evidence — must be human-verified before any 'current officer' use
freshness_rules.likely_stale: reserved — a named officer whose page predates a known term boundary (unquantifiable without term data)

eligibility_rule: outreach_eligible = true when contact_type != unknown AND confidence != low AND NOT (named officer without effective_term). Named officers => verify_before_use => NOT eligible until King verifies. Low-confidence => NOT eligible. Unknown => NOT eligible (triage).

merge_variable_qa_contract.note: Every generated variable MUST expose all four attributes. A variable with no established value is {value:null}. Term/year is never invented.

chapter.missing_action: omit or NEEDS_REVIEW if template requires

council.missing_action: omit or NEEDS_REVIEW if template requires

merge_variable_qa_contract.email_gating_rule: email_status = READY only if every REQUIRED variable has a non-null value AND confidence not in ['low'] AND (for officer-implying templates) freshness_status != verify_before_use. Otherwise email_status = NEEDS_REVIEW. NEEDS_REVIEW is never auto-sent; it goes to King.

actions.APPROVE: Contact + variables are correct; mark usable. Sets qc_action=approve, qc_by, qc_at. If freshness=verify_before_use, APPROVE also asserts the officer is current (optionally set effective_term).
actions.EDIT: Fix a field (name/role/email/instagram/council/campaign_purpose). Stores changes in qc_edits {field:newValue}; qc_action=edit. Edits are applied to the working contact, source row preserved.
actions.WRONG_DATA: A specific value is wrong (wrong person / wrong instagram / wrong org / wrong council). qc_action=wrong_data + qc_notes naming the wrong variable; contact excluded from outreach until corrected.
actions.REJECT: Contact is unusable (bad email, not a real contact, opted out). qc_action=reject; permanently excluded.
actions.SKIP: Defer decision. qc_action=skip; returns to queue later. No state change to eligibility.

monthly: only contacts a live campaign targets near a term boundary
